{"basis": "The dashboard uses a dual-axis chart where the left axis represents 'Married couple' (blue) and the right axis represents 'Single women' (red). The 2020 data point for 'Single women' is plotted near the top of the chart, while the 2020 data point for 'Married couple' is plotted near the bottom. In the absence of explicit numerical labels for the 2020 points, the relative vertical positioning on their respective axes indicates that the 'Single women' count is significantly larger than the 'Married couple' count for that year. Therefore, the follow-up record for the group with the larger count is 'Single women'."
